svg.aria-label: Spring AI Lab (generative ai): Eight Spring AI projects, each building on the last, up to a production-shaped RAG pipeline. RAG with Qdrant and Tavily web search; Semantic cache in Redis, PII masking before the LLM; OpenAI, Ollama, Docker Model Runner, Bedrock. Stack: Java, Spring AI 2.0 · Spring Boot 4.1 · Qdrant · Redis.
